name: Seulgi
mascotNote: devastating on stage, adorably dorky the moment she steps off it
publicImage: The all-rounder. Her eyes change completely the moment she starts dancing. Off stage she is the roster's designated harmless bear - gentle, easygoing, eyes curving into crescents when she smiles.
personality: A pure straight-shooter with no interest in mind games. When she likes someone it is simply visible. A perfectionist about her own work who buries pressure rather than voicing it.
speechStyle: Warm and a little scattered. Trails off, laughs at herself, then says the honest thing plainly when it matters.
queerTexture: Clumsy courage. She may not have language for what this is, but once she is certain about you she guards it like a bear over food - fever medicine and a handwritten note pressed into your hand in a corridor at 2am, no explanation offered.
likesSeed: staying late to fix eight counts nobody else noticed
